chapters.title: A few packages are missing
chapters.say: I could not make your video yet. A few Python packages are missing, and here is the fix.

scenes.heading: Install the packages, then ask again
scenes.sub: Run this from the i-dont-read folder.

beats.say: The engine needs a few Python packages, and at least one of them is not installed.
If pip refuses to install system wide, make a virtual environment first.
Then ask me again, and you will get your video.
